instruction: Identify the sales representative with the highest total sales across all months and highlight their entire data row with any background color.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding top performer by total sales. Verified with Python: Kandice Hussey (row 10) has highest total of 3000 (752+773+483+220+597+175). Evaluator checks if row 10 (A10:G10) has background fill applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts row fill state from the specified row (row 10, columns 1-7) using openpyxl
Metric correctly checks if any fill is applied, which aligns with instruction requirement for 'any background color'
Expected value is semantically correct - row 10 was verified through data analysis as having the highest total sales (Kandice Hussey, total 3000)
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before reading to ensure state is persisted
Complete coverage of instruction requirements: identifies correct row and verifies highlighting
Getter logic handles fill detection correctly by checking fill_type is not None and not 'none'
Data flow is correct: getter extracts fill state -> metric checks if fill exists -> expected requires fill present
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter accepts partial row highlighting (has_fill=true if any cell has fill). Could be stricter by requiring all cells to have fill (filled_count == total_cells), but current approach is pragmatically acceptable since users typically highlight entire rows
